messages:
anna: Heads-up — deploy-bot skipped the ECR publish for image redwood/release-2.14.0:20260314 because provenance attestation was not found in provenance-store. @kai @maria any visibility? :warning:

deploy-bot: publish skipped — provenance-attestor returned 404 for signature.
Logs snippet:
```
POST /ecr/publish
status=skipped
reason="attestation_missing"
image=redwood/release-2.14.0:20260314
sha=sha256:abc12345
```

kai: I saw a transient stalling on the attestor earlier today, it was retrying against KMS. Sounds like eventual consistency between the builder and attestation service — can you check attestor and builder timestamps? :eyes:

maria: I dug into the build pipeline — the image push succeeded but the sign-and-upload stage failed due to an IAM token expiry on the attestation job. We can re-run attestation and then retrigger publish. Ops team, any objection to a quick replay?

jamie: Reminder we have the change window at 18:00 UTC. Do we want to re-sign and republish in-window or push out-of-window? Downstream consumers have pinned the tag for rollout, so short gap is OK, but we should avoid unsafe workarounds.

anna: Options: A) re-run attestation now and republish (preferred). B) retag the already-pushed layer and publish without attestation (not acceptable for prod). No bypasses.

kai: I'll attempt a replay-attest now against the attestation service. If it fails we'll move to the 18:00 window.

kai: ran replay-attest — logs show: sign job retried, token refresh succeeded, signed artifact uploaded. Triggering deploy-bot retry now.

deploy-bot: retry queued by @kai. Starting publish attempt... status=publishing... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: publish succeeded. image=redwood/release-2.14.0:20260314 digest=sha256:abc12345 signed=true provenance=attestations/redwood/release-2.14.0/sha256:abc12345 :shipit:

maria: Thanks — I'll update the release notes and the release board to reflect a short publish delay and attach the attestation path. Updating: https://go.redwood/release/2.14.0

anna: @deploy-bot please add an audit log entry noting the skipped publish and subsequent replay+publish. We want these in the release postmortem if it recurs.

deploy-bot: logged event: publish_skipped_then_republished; reason=attestation_missing_then_replayed; ticket=ENG-5123

jamie: Can we also add an alert when the attestor returns missing-signature for >1 minute after a successful push? This would catch problems faster.

kai: Filed follow-up ENG-5124 to add alerting + improve retry/backoff for the attestor. Assigning to myself.

maria: :thumbsup: Closing — release published, no rollback required. I'll monitor metrics in the next hour and update if anything odd shows up.
